title: Copy of the ordinary cipher of the States General and their ambassadors ('t'Ordinaris Chyffer van Haer Ho: Mo: ende derselver Ambassadeurs etc.'), about 1655
shelfmark: Rigsarkivet, TKUA, Speciel del, Nederlandene B.44 (1646-59), folder Peder Charisius 1655; Arkivalieronline unit 261381, images 442-444
what: Homophonic alphabet a = 4-8, b = 9-10, c = 11-12, d = 13-14, e = 15-19 ... u = 54-58, w = 59-60, x = 61-62, y = 63-67, z = 68-69, and 'Nomina quaedam propria': 71 Duytslant, 97 Brunswyck, 98 Lunenburgh, 108 Lubeck, 110 Hamburgh, 113 De Geunieerde Provincien, 114 De Staten Generael, 117 Haer Ho: Mo: vloote, 127 Denemarcken, 128 De Con. van Denemarcken, 134 Sweden, 135 De Con. van Sweden, 140 Dantsick, 157 Engelant, 16x Cromwel, 169 desselfs Raet oft Raet van Engelant, 170 Vranckryck, 190 Con. van Spaignen, 289 Resident. Two copies (442 right, 443 right) with an endorsement naming it the cipher for the States' ambassadors, deputies and other ministers.
use: A Dutch diplomatic cipher of the 1650s obtained by the Danish resident: test on undeciphered States-General despatches of 1653-58 (Nationaal Archief, Thurloe intercepts).
seen: scan, full-size crop of 442 right; 443-444 at 1000 px
